# DatetimePicker { #anylumino.DatetimePicker }

```python
DatetimePicker(
    value=None,
    description='',
    disabled=False,
)
```

Datetime picker control.

The frontend renders separate date and time inputs. The time input uses the
same anylumino hour/minute popup as `TimePicker`, so users can pick any minute
value instead of being limited to fixed 15-minute increments.

Python `datetime.datetime` values are accepted and serialized with
`isoformat()` before syncing to the frontend.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name        | Type     | Description                            | Default   |
|-------------|----------|----------------------------------------|-----------|
| value | `datetime.datetime`, `str`, or `None` | Initial value and synced Python value. Strings should use an ISO datetime value compatible with browser date and time inputs. | `None` |
| description | optional | Label shown above the control. | `''` |
| disabled | optional | Whether user interaction is disabled. | `False` |

## Attributes

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [control_kind](#anylumino.DatetimePicker.control_kind) | A trait for unicode strings. |
